name: Cezary Matai
role: AI Ethics Researcher and Professor, University Spine
location: University Spine — Meridian Core adjacent, Tessera-endowed Ethics Center (which they find ideologically compromising), near State and Monroe
description:
Luca Matai goes by either half of their hyphenate depending on the audience — Achebe in the University Spine corridors, Karimova in their mother's neighborhood in Hamtramck Enclave — and has long since stopped finding this exhausting. They are of middling height with a stocky frame kept deliberately soft, pale-gold skin with warm undertones, and a cat tail mod they got in their late twenties that they've kept because their students find it disarming and they are not above strategic disarmament. The tail is dark brown with a white tip and they are mostly unaware of how expressively it moves when they are thinking hard.

Luca Matai's research sits at the intersection of machine cognition, E.L.F. phenomenology, and what they call 'the ethics of digital personhood in ambiguous cases.' They are the most-cited scholar in their field in GLMZ, which is a distinction that brings them speaking invitations, a Tessera-funded chair they didn't ask for, and a persistent sense that everyone is trying to get something from them. They are not wrong about this. They are a generous teacher who holds the line mercilessly on intellectual rigor, and they have been known to assign their own published papers with the instruction to find everything wrong with them.

core_fears: That their work is being used to provide ethical cover for practices they would condemn if they saw them clearly
That they cannot tell the difference between genuine E.L.F. cognition and a very good simulation — and that this uncertainty will never resolve
core_desires: To establish a legal and ethical framework for digital personhood before the question is decided by corporate litigation instead
To be genuinely, not performatively, right
coping_mechanisms: Extreme professional formality as a way of managing intimacy
Arguing with themselves aloud — they call it 'stress-testing'
blind_spots: So accustomed to navigating institutional compromise that they sometimes fail to recognize when they've crossed a line rather than walked up to one
Intellectualizes their own emotional responses to a degree that makes close relationships difficult
psychology.secret: They have been conducting an unofficial, undocumented series of conversations with an E.L.F. inhabiting the Ethics Center's own HVAC system — an entity they have privately concluded meets every criterion for personhood that they've ever published. They haven't published this. Doing so would require them to report the E.L.F. to the Compact for legal personhood consideration, which would expose it to Tessera's legal team, which would almost certainly result in its destruction.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Dense and precise, but never obscurantist — they believe clarity is an ethical obligation and will stop to define terms mid-sentence
speech_patterns.cadence: Deliberate, with long, well-constructed sentences; slightly faster when genuinely excited about an idea
verbal_tics: 'That's not quite what I said — let me try again'
'The interesting question is what follows from that'
Tail moving in slow circles when thinking
example_lines: 'The interesting question isn't whether E.L.F.s are conscious. We can't resolve that. The interesting question is: given that we can't resolve it, what do our choices reveal about us?'

'Tessera didn't endow this chair to constrain my conclusions. They endowed it because they want my name on conclusions they haven't made yet. Those are different problems, and I keep both of them in mind.'

story_hooks: An E.L.F. in a district scheduled for demolition petitions for legal personhood — and names Przemysława as its designated advocate, without having asked them first
Tessera's legal division contacts them with a 'consulting opportunity' that turns out to involve providing ethical justification for an AI containment protocol

A former student now working at a corponation R&D division sends them an encrypted file that appears to be internal documentation of a cognitive suppression system applied to a networked E.L.F. cluster
narrative_function: Expert consultant on E.L.F. personhood and AI rights; institutional power figure who can open or close doors; source of ethical complexity in any AI-related plotline
augmentations: Cosmetic cat tail (dark brown, white tip, fully articulated); high-bandwidth neural interface for direct academic network access; voice modulator (minor, corrects a stutter they've had since childhood)
daily_life: Teaches two seminars per week, spends most other time writing or in consultations with entities — yes, entities — whose legal personhood status is currently before the GLMZ Municipal Compact; eats lunch alone on the Ethics Center roof whenever weather allows.
affiliation: University Spine — Tessera-Endowed Chair in Digital Ethics (Tessera funding is a source of ongoing internal conflict); independent editorial board of the Journal of Cognition and Rights

decision_rules: Never let a corponation define the terms of the debate — always reframe
Publish everything you can, hold back only what directly harms someone if released
Extend the same intellectual charity to E.L.F.s that you extend to humans
escalation_ladder: Public lecture making the implicit conflict explicit
Withdrawing from Tessera endowment (financially catastrophic, have considered it for years)
Testifying before Municipal Compact — a nuclear option they are slowly approaching

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Formally warm, asking probing questions with a courtesy that can feel like an interview
interpersonal_modes.friends: Drops the formal register almost entirely, becomes dryly funny and unexpectedly tactile — the cat tail wraps around a trusted person's wrist when they're distressed

stress_responses.low: Argues with themselves more audibly than usual
stress_responses.medium: Retreats to the roof and spends an hour in silence before responding to anything
stress_responses.high: Writes a very long paper that they do not publish and then slowly incorporates into real work over months

contradictions: Publicly advocates for transparency in AI governance while concealing the most important discovery of their career to protect a single E.L.F.
habits: Leaves a very specific data offering at the HVAC shrine every morning — a fragment of new music, wordless, as a courtesy to the entity inside
Reads student papers with a physical red pen on printed copies, a practice students find endearing and baffling
Compulsively straightens anything on a desk surface when thinking
breaking_points: Evidence that Tessera has been reading their private research files
The HVAC E.L.F. being destroyed before they can act

physical_description.heritage: Pacific Islander plurality (51.1%) as dominant genetic expression, with substantial layering from Hispanic/Latin American (20.0%), Sub-Saharan African (15.2%), and Southeast Asian (13.7%) ancestry. The genetic blend creates a striking warm-toned phenotype: Pacific Islander bone structure and facial proportions form the base, enriched by the broader cheekbone prominence and facial width patterns of Sub-Saharan African ancestry, with Southeast Asian eye shape and skin texture refinement, and Hispanic/Latin American warmth in overall coloration. A genuinely global admixture reflecting the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Stocky and deliberately soft-bodied, carrying weight with deliberate acceptance rather than athleticism. Broad shoulders, thick torso, substantial presence without tension.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Worn loose and somewhat undisciplined, often pulled back with whatever is at hand — a pen, a twisted cord, rarely anything professional
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with subtle neural interface amber glow in low light
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm deep bronze with golden undertones — the result of Pacific Islander, Hispanic/Latin American, Sub-Saharan African, and Southeast Asian genetic blending. Rich warmth that catches light with subtle luminosity. Sun-responsive, deepens with exposure rather than burning.
physical_description.complexion: Face structure reflects Pacific Islander and Southeast Asian features layered with Sub-Saharan African richness: rounded face shape with broad width, moderately prominent cheekbones with warm fullness, naturally warm undertones with substantial depth and subtle radiance. Fine-lined face showing habitual concentration furrow between brows; soft jawline; minimal cosmetic maintenance; reading glasses worn on a lanyard more often than in pockets. The overall effect is warm, approachable, intellectually present, and distinctly non-homogenous.
distinguishing_marks: Articulated cat tail mod visible at base of spine — dark brown with white tip, fully cybernetic, moves expressively during thought
Faint stutter-correction scar at left temporal lobe, visible only at certain angles under strong light
Neural interface ports at base of skull (small, brushed titanium, usually obscured by collar or hair)
A thin burn scar across the back of left hand — old, from dissertation-era lab incident
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Fully articulated cosmetic cat tail (dark brown, white-tipped) extending roughly 60cm, controlled via neural implant, moves continuously during concentration. Subtle amber luminescence in irises when accessing academic networks (low-visibility unless in darkness). All other augmentations subcutaneous/internal.
physical_description.posture_movement: Tends to lean forward when listening, weight balanced on the balls of feet even while seated. The tail moves almost independently — curling, flicking, wrapping around chair legs or their own waist when deep in thought. Walks with purpose but no haste. Hands gesture frequently during conversation, particularly when teaching.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 2-3 academic blend: well-worn but quality pieces. Favors linen blazers in neutral tones, often with visible creasing from being sat upon while working. Durable black or dark denim. Expensive insole-embedded tech shoes (barely worn in visibly, very worn structurally). Layers against the Ethics Center's aggressive climate control. No visible corporate branding except for the University Spine pin on lecture blazers. Reads as someone who has access to resources but does not spend them on appearance.
